escalation_action: Serum acetaminophen level at 4 hours post-ingestion, immediate IV or oral N-acetylcysteine (NAC) protocol before 8 hours post-ingestion.

title: Massive Arterial Hemorrhage
red_flags: pulsatile bright red arterial bleeding from extremity
triage_criteria: Patient presents with pulsatile bright red arterial bleeding from extremity, failing direct pressure, rapid hypovolemic shock. Requires evaluation according to clinical evidence guidelines.
escalation_action: Immediate application of combat application tourniquet (CAT) 2-3 inches proximal to injury site, tighten until bleeding ceases, log tourniquet time.
